events.event: Begin common-calibration/metric-compatibility route: audit the erroneous corpus proposal and seek an exact closed-form compatibility reduction.

Derived and wrote the characteristic-form compatibility theorem for three independent bivectors, and a flat-torus counterexample to the common-calibration necessity claim. The global choice of compatible closed forms is still unproved.
Begin local second-jet obstruction route and check whether independent isotopy destroys it.
Completed metric-independent second-jet obstruction and explicit taut torus pair. Verified a separate isotopy removes the obstruction; no counterexample to the source question is claimed.
Begin compact-leaf homology route, seeking an obstruction invariant under independent isotopies.
Proved proportional-homology compact leaves must be common leaves, and derived an ambient-leaf-isotopy-class obstruction. No explicit violating pair or sufficiency theorem was established.
Begin conformal PDE route; seek a complete criterion inside a specified conformal class and identify its limitation for unrestricted metrics.

Derived the exact conformal criterion, including zero periods, and a torus metric with a nonclosed compatibility form. The same collection works in the flat metric, so no unrestricted obstruction is claimed.
Begin constructive deformation route: trace positive torus families and test whether their smooth construction can extend the primary PL remark to arbitrary taut collections.

Completed positive one-variable torus models and a concrete failure of metric averaging. The smooth gluing and arbitrary-isotopy compatibility step is unproved. Five approaches end with scoped partials, not a general resolution.

qualification: A route is a distinct proof strategy with a documented conclusion and gap, not a separate complete solution.
